name: Musical Instrument, Morphing
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot -; Price +300 gp; Weight varies

DESCRIPTION

This musical instrument bears motifs ofvarious other instruments and performance types.

A musical instrument can be crafted with this enchantment which allows it to change shape into any other musical instrument of the same or smaller size than the original instrument. Shifting the instrument is a move action which does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, summon instrument; Price +150 gp
